2. Heard Sri Krishna Dev Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ajay Singh, learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the record.

3. The present petition u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Praveen with the following prayers:
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow this application and quashing the impugned charge sheet dated 22.08.2017, as well as cognizance order dated 03.10.2017, arising out of Case Crime Praveen vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2342311/
1 No. 344 of 2017, U/S- 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section- 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Dadri, District- Gautam-Budh-Nagar in Special Case No. 257 of 2017 (State vs. Praveen), pending in the court of Learned Additional District Judge/Special Judge (POCSO-II), Gautam Budh Nagar.

entities.text: Case Crime Praveen vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Additional District Judge/Special Judge (POCSO-II), Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is further be pleased to stay the entire proceeding of Special Case No. 257 of 2017 (State vs. Praveen), pending in the court of Learned Additional District Judge/Special Judge (POCSO-II), Gautam Budh Nagar, during the pendency of the present application before this Hon'ble Court.
And/or to pass such other and further orders, which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case, otherwise, the applicants shall suffer irreparable loss and injury."
4. After arguments at length, learned counsel for the applicant submits that he does not want to press the prayer of this petition.

entities.text: Additional District Judge/Special Judge (POCSO-II), Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He further submits that since non bailable warrants have been issued in the year 2021 liberty be granted to him to approach before the trial court concerned for filing an application for bail/application for recall of non bailable warrants issued against him for which a direction be issued to the court concerned to pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.
5. Learned counsel for the State submits that he has no objection the said proposition.
6. In view of the above, the prayer for quashing of charge sheet/cognizance order is dismissed as not pressed.

7. However, it is provided that if the applicant appears before the concerned trial court within two weeks from today and files an application for bail/application for recall of non bailable warrants, the same shall be considered and decided as expeditiously as possible in accordance with law.
8. For a period of two weeks from today, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 15.4.2024 Naresh  Praveen vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2342311/
